scope: All 14 FY2025-26 credits that remained after the 8 September approved expense batch, plus a read-only missing-fact inventory for the eight remaining FY debits.
guardrails: No new invoice, income transaction, account, bank rule, transfer, payment commitment or outbound communication was created.
Only the Hab receipt was reconciled because the payer identity, existing invoice contact evidence, amount and unpaid balance were unequivocal and no conflicting match was present.
Direct tuition treatments below are proposals for parent judgement, not postings.
Bank descriptions that state Mandarin, Chinese lessons, term fees, lessons, student or classes are retained as purpose evidence rather than labelled as no evidence.
BAS Excluded is the established non-GST treatment for direct tuition receipts in this reconstruction; no GST is claimed.
evidence_sources: live Xero Bank Reconciliation and Review reconciled in the signed-in Max Chrome session
